entities.name: Kim Jong-un

entities.name: Tim Cook

entities.name: Procter & Gamble

entities.name: François Hollande

He was the first Socialist Party candidate to be elected President of the Fifth Republic and is known for his social democratic policies, including the legalization of same-sex marriage and his response to the 2015 Paris attacks.

entities.name: Angela Merkel
entities.explicit_context: Angela Dorothea Merkel (born 17 July 1954) is a German politician who served as Chancellor of Germany from 2005 to 2021. entities.name: Narendra Modi

entities.name: Justin Trudeau

entities.name: Prof. Stephen Hawking
entities.explicit_context: Stephen William Hawking (8 January 1942 – 14 March 2018) was an English theoretical physicist, cosmologist, and author who was director of research at the Centre for Theoretical Cosmology at the University of Cambridge. Despite being diagnosed with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) at age 21, he made groundbreaking contributions to our understanding of black holes, the Big Bang, and the nature of the universe.

entities.name: Gen. Colin Powell

entities.name: Rev. Martin Luther King Jr
entities.explicit_context: Martin Luther King Jr. (born Michael King Jr.; January 15, 1929 – April 4, 1968) was an American Baptist minister and activist who became the most visible spokesperson and leader in the civil rights movement from 1955 until his assassination in 1968. He is best known for his role in the advancement of civil rights using nonviolent civil disobedience based on his Christian beliefs.
